crowdcontrol.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Crowd Control right now.

crowdcontrol.getSession.description: Tells you about the Crowd Control game session that is running, and the timed effects that are active.
crowdcontrol.getSession.returns: active (true while a session runs), paused, gameSessionId, gameName, gamePackName and timedEffects (a list: requestId, effectName, user, status, timeRemaining in milliseconds).

crowdcontrol.sendTestEvent.description: Fakes a Crowd Control event inside Cuebot, so you can test your triggers. Nothing is sent to Crowd Control. Other kinds: effectFailure, effectRefund, timedEffectUpdated, timedEffectEnded, gameSessionEnd.
crowdcontrol.sendTestEvent.returns: true when the test event was sent, false when the kind is unknown.
